verdict.rationale: Calendly's own AI assistant, Callie (beta), coordinates scheduling over email threads. Calendly also checks multiple connected calendars for conflicts and offers group polls that account for everyone's availability, which a community user corroborates. Nothing in the evidence shows AI choosing an optimal time across all attendees or re-optimizing meetings after booking; the documented model is invitees picking from open slots. missing for 10: AI ranking or optimization of the best time across all attendees' calendars, continuous re-optimization or auto-rescheduling of existing meetings, documented depth of how Callie selects times, independent hands-on corroboration of AI time selection.
